content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":true,"reason":"Sells billing and customer care software plus managed billing operations to telecom, cable and media operators, closely matching Amdocs' core business."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Customer engagement and knowledge software for enterprises across many industries; telecom is only one end market."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Designs network security hardware and security software; sells to a broad enterprise and government base, not operator billing or operations."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Point-of-sale hardware and payments for restaurants and retailers; different products and customers."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Enterprise storage hardware and data management software; no overlap with operator software or managed telecom operations."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Application development, data integration and infrastructure tools sold to enterprise IT teams, not telecom operators."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Sells IP communications hardware appliances and session border controllers; network infrastructure, not billing or operator business software."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Cloud phone, meetings and contact center subscriptions for businesses of all sizes; different product and customer base."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Enterprise social media and customer experience platform for brands; marketing-oriented, not operator billing or network operations."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Financial services software and outsourced fund administration for asset managers and banks; different industry and customers."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Cloud work management and content software for enterprises and government; no telecom or media focus."}]}
